name: Mastodon
tagline: Decentralized social networking API for federated Mastodon instances
description: Mastodon is a free, open-source, decentralized social network based on ActivityPub. Each instance runs its own Mastodon server with a REST API for timelines, posts (statuses), accounts, media, notifications, and OAuth-based client apps. Developers target a specific instance base URL rather than a single global host; the API is largely the same across servers.

auth.details: OAuth 2.0 (client credentials or authorization code). Register an app via POST /api/v1/apps, then obtain a bearer token; send Authorization: Bearer ACCESS_TOKEN on API requests. Some public read endpoints work without auth.

pricing.free_tier_limits: API access is free on self-hosted or public instances; no central paid API product. Instance operators set their own limits.

rate_limits: Default ~300 requests per 5 minutes per IP/user (varies by instance; check X-RateLimit-* headers). Not a global SLA.
use_cases: post a status to a Mastodon account
fetch a user's public timeline or home feed
search accounts and hashtags on an instance
upload media and attach it to a toot
stream notifications or public timeline updates
look up account profiles by username
